items.title: Show HN: Flide: Make Jev-like decision models up to 9.5x faster
items.title_cn: Show HN: Flide ：使类似Jev的决策模型速度提高9.5倍
items.summary: Decision models need their own inference engine. So we developed Flide, a high-performance and exact inference engine for Jev-like decision models. Flide achieves up to a 9.5x speedup over vLLM and SGLang. It now supports 30+ popular local Jev-like decision models. Start to make your decision immediately: pip install flide
items.summary_cn: 决策模型需要自己的推理引擎。因此，我们开发了Flide ，这是一种适用于类似Jev的决策模型的高性能和精确推理引擎。FLIDE比vLLM和SGLang加速高达9.5倍。它现在支持30多个流行的类似Jev的本地决策模型。立即开始做出决定： pip install flide
